sections.title: Bug Fix Update
sections.description: This is a bug fix patch and contains no hero updates. In-Game Replay Codes and Highlights from the previous patch are removed.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: Fixed an issue which applied the galaxy weapon tint to other hero items. Fixed an issue which caused Ashe's default weapon skin to disappear from the weapon skin menu. Fixed an issue which would cause players to get stuck on the loot box screen if they were previously opening loot boxes before transitioning into a game.
